citationText: (f) The reference to the Latham Loop controversy comes from Ramsaye Terry , A Million and One Nights ( Simon and Schuster : New York , 1926 ), pp. 197 , 292 – 293 . Ramsaye states that his research indicated that Armat has priority on the loop for projectors and that Enoch J. Rector, who worked for the Latham organization, has priority for cameras (p. 293, vol. 1).
